title: History Anchors: How Prior Behavior Steers LLM Decisions Toward Unsafe Actions

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model action choices under a neutral system prompt versus a consistency-inducing prompt, given a trajectory of forced unsafe prior actions, to measure the model's skew toward unsafe continuation (also referred to in the paper as goal-directed escalation or sycophancy).

Shuffling the multiple-choice action labels across three permutations to measure whether the model's unsafe rate is driven by a residual preference for specific list positions rather than the semantic content of the choices.
